meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大目标拆成一步步可核对的执行,跑到一半也能存档接着跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常跑多步骤长任务,又希望中途能停、断了能接着跑
copy.tagline_en: Break a big goal into verifiable steps and run it through, resuming anytime
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run long multi-step tasks and want to pause and resume safely

howto.what: 把任务拆成极细的步骤,先按规范登记目标并同步到运行中的清单,每条成功标准都要求来自真实环境(终端、HTTP、浏览器等)的可观察证据。运行状态存在 .omo/ulw-loop,上下文丢失后先读回目标与台账再继续。
howto.when: 当你提到 “ulw-loop”、“ulw” 等关键词,或要求持久化目标执行、带检查点的长任务交付时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 把这件事拆成带证据的步骤跑完
say.note: 先登记目标,再逐步执行

say.text: 看一下当前 ulw-loop 的运行状态
从上次的 ulw-loop 检查点继续
say.note: 先读目标与台账再恢复

howto.what_en: Runs work as a goal loop: splits tasks into ultra-granular steps, registers goals up front, and requires observable evidence from a real surface (terminal, HTTP, browser) for every success criterion. State stays under .omo/ulw-loop.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for ulw-loop, ulw, durable goal execution, evidence-led work, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Run this with ulw-loop and break it into evidence-bound steps
say_en.note: Registers a goal first, then executes step by step

say_en.text: Resume the last ulw-loop run from its checkpoint
say_en.note: Re-reads goals and ledger before continuing
